# Linkable

> Linkable is where ecommerce brands find creators and run every collaboration in one place. You launch a campaign, creators apply, you choose who to work with, and Linkable handles samples, content, usage rights, tracking and commission payouts.

Linkable has two sides. Brands run creator campaigns: the pages under "For brands". Creators apply to those campaigns and pitch brands directly with Pitch: the pages under "For creators". Prices below are in US dollars; UK brands pay in British pounds and brands in Europe in euros.

## For brands

- [Creator Marketing for Ecommerce Brands](https://www.linkable.link/): Run gifted, paid and affiliate creator campaigns in one place. Find relevant creators, manage collaborations, get content and track performance with Linkable.
- [Autopilot: Creator Campaigns That Run Themselves](https://www.linkable.link/autopilot): Autopilot sets up your creator campaigns, sources and matches creators and keeps every collaboration moving, so your team doesn’t have to.
- [Creator Marketing Pricing for Ecommerce Brands](https://www.linkable.link/pricing): Explore Linkable pricing for ecommerce brands. Find creators and run gifted, paid and affiliate campaigns, with everything managed in one place.

### Plans for brands

- Free: $0 forever. For brands working with their own creators. Unlimited private campaigns. Your own application link to share. Samples, content and usage rights handled. No card needed.
- Starter: $99 a month (or $990 a year, save 17%). For brands getting started with creators. Work with up to 10 new creators a month. Run up to 2 public campaigns at once. Unlimited private campaigns. Campaign and creator insights. Dedicated support and onboarding.
- Growth: $199 a month (or $1,990 a year, save 17%). For brands working with creators every month. Work with up to 50 new creators a month. Run up to 10 public campaigns at once. Unlimited private campaigns. Campaign and creator insights. Dedicated support and onboarding.
- Scale: $499 a month (or $4,990 a year, save 17%). For brands running a full creator program. Work with up to 100 new creators a month. Run up to 20 public campaigns at once. Unlimited private campaigns. Advanced campaign and creator insights. Priority support and onboarding.

### Questions brands ask

- **What is Linkable?** Linkable is where ecommerce brands find creators and run every collaboration in one place. You launch a campaign, creators apply, you choose who to work with, and Linkable handles samples, content, usage rights, tracking and commission payouts.
- **How do I find the right creators?** Creators in our network apply to your campaign, and AI matching suggests the best fits with the reasons they suit your brand. You can also invite creators directly. You always choose who you work with.
- **What can I offer creators?** Free product, a fixed fee, commission on sales, or any mix of the three. You set it per campaign.
- **Do I need a Shopify store?** No. Linkable works without Shopify. Connect it when you want product sync, automatic audience discounts and sales attribution.
- **How does the free trial work?** Every paid plan is free for the first 30 days, with full access to the platform. Change plan or cancel any time.
- **What counts towards my monthly creator limit?** Each new creator you start working with in a month counts once. Applications and invitations are unlimited on every plan.
- **What is the 2.5% fee?** It applies only to sales tracked through creator links. Everything else is covered by your plan.
- **Who owns the content creators make?** You agree usage rights in each campaign, and they are saved with every piece of content in your library, so you always know where you can use it.
- **Can your team run campaigns for us?** Yes. Our managed service plans your campaigns, finds the right creators and manages every collaboration from start to finish. Talk to our team to set it up.
- **Is there a free plan?** Yes. On the Free plan you run unlimited private campaigns with your own creators, shared through your own application link, free forever. You only pay 2.5% of creator driven sales. On Free, Linkable doesn’t bring you creators or reach out to them for you. Upgrade any time to get creators from Linkable applying too.
- **Can I change plan later?** Yes. Move up or down a plan, or cancel, whenever you need to.
- **How does yearly billing work?** Pay once a year and save 17% compared with paying monthly.
- **Which currency are prices in?** Prices are shown in US dollars. UK brands pay in British pounds, brands in Europe pay in euros, and everyone else pays in US dollars.
- **How much does the managed service cost?** It depends on the campaigns you want us to run. Talk to our team and we’ll put together a plan for your brand.

## For creators

- [Brand Collaborations for Creators](https://www.linkable.link/creators): Discover gifted, paid and affiliate collaborations with ecommerce brands. Create content, promote products you love and earn through Linkable.
- [Pitch Brands With AI: Land Brand Deals as a Creator](https://www.linkable.link/pitch): Find brands worth pitching, get a pitch written for you and sent to the person who runs partnerships, with follow ups handled. Free for 10 pitches a month.

### Plans for creators

- Free: $0. Every creator gets 10 pitches a month for free, follow ups included. Pitch Pro gives you unlimited pitches to brands on Linkable, 100 a month to any other brand, and Auto Pitch, which pitches 25 brands for you every week.
- Pitch Pro: $19 a month (or $190 a year, save 17%).

### Questions creators ask

- **Is Linkable free for creators?** Yes. Creating a profile, applying to campaigns and pitching brands is always free.
- **Do I need a big following?** No. Brands look for creators who fit their audience, not just the biggest numbers. Many campaigns are open to smaller creators.
- **How do I get paid?** Commission is tracked through your own link and paid out to you. Fixed fees are agreed with each brand before you start.
- **Which platforms can I use?** Instagram and TikTok. Connect your accounts and your audience insights are added to your profile automatically.
- **What can I pitch?** Any idea for a brand on Linkable. Set the content, the deliverables and your rate, and the brand replies in your inbox.
- **Who owns the content I make?** You do. Usage rights are agreed per campaign, so you always know how a brand can use your content.
- **Can I work with brands outside the UK?** Yes. Brands on Linkable work with creators in many countries, and each campaign shows where it ships.
- **Is Pitch free?** Yes. Every creator gets 10 pitches a month for free, follow ups included. Pitch Pro gives you unlimited pitches to brands on Linkable, 100 a month to any other brand, and Auto Pitch, which pitches 25 brands for you every week.
- **Which brands can I pitch?** Any brand you want to work with, including brands that aren’t on Linkable yet. Linkable also suggests brands that fit your niche and audience.
- **Who receives my pitch?** We find the person who runs creator partnerships at the brand and send your pitch to them, not to a generic inbox.
- **Can I edit the pitch before it’s sent?** Yes. Everything AI drafts is yours to change, from the idea to what you’ll create and what you ask for.
- **Can I cancel Pitch Pro?** Yes, any time. You keep Pro until the end of your billing period, then move back to the free plan.
- **Is there a yearly plan?** Yes. Pay for Pitch Pro once a year and save 17% compared with paying monthly.
